name: Spinach Artichoke Dip

ingredients.item: frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry

instructions: Mix cream cheese, sour cream, and mayonnaise until smooth.
Stir in spinach, artichokes, garlic, half the mozzarella, and parmesan.
Transfer to a baking dish. Top with remaining mozzarella.
Bake 20-25 minutes until bubbly and golden on top.
Serve hot with tortilla chips, pita, or crusty bread.

substitutions.dairy_free: Use dairy-free cream cheese, sour cream, and vegan mozzarella.
substitutions.gluten_free: Serve with gluten-free chips or veggies — the dip itself is gluten-free.
substitutions.low_carb: Serve with celery, cucumber, or bell pepper strips.
